Privacy Policy

Last updated: 2026-10-03

Status

DRAFT FOR LEGAL REVIEW: replace bracketed placeholders and have a qualified lawyer review this page before launch.

Who we are

ImageTo20KB (https://www.imageto20kb.in/) is operated by [OPERATOR NAME – TO BE CONFIRMED].

Your images

Images you select are read, decoded, resized and re-encoded inside your browser using the Canvas API. The compression feature does not upload your images to our servers or to any third-party image service. Images exist only in your device’s memory and as temporary browser object URLs until you remove them or close the page.

Data we collect

The current version of the site has no analytics, no advertising scripts and no contact form (email only). Our hosting provider (Cloudflare) may process technical data such as IP address and request headers to deliver the site and protect it from abuse, under its own policies. [Update this section if analytics or a contact form is added.]

Browser storage

The site stores your light/dark theme choice in your browser’s localStorage. It is not used for tracking and is not sent to us.

Your rights and contact

Depending on where you live you may have rights to access, correct or delete personal data we hold. Because we do not intentionally collect personal data through the tool, there is usually nothing to retrieve, but you can email us at compressimageto@gmail.com.

Changes

We may update this policy; the “last updated” date on the page will change.

What “processed locally” means

When you add an image, your browser reads the file, decodes it, draws it on a canvas, and creates a new compressed file on your device. The page does not send the image or its contents to our servers for this. Temporary browser links are used to show previews and downloads; the page releases them when you remove a file or leave the page.

What the website itself may receive

Like any website, requests to load pages reach our hosting provider, which can see technical information such as IP address, browser type and requested page. We do not use this to identify you and we do not combine it with your images, because we never receive your images through the tool. Hosting providers may keep security and performance logs under their own policies.

Children

The tool is not directed at children and we do not knowingly collect personal data from them. Anyone preparing a photo of a child should make sure they have the right to process it.

International use

The site is delivered through a global network, so technical request data may be processed in different countries. [Update with the operator’s data-transfer position after legal review.]

Legal bases and purposes

Where privacy law requires a legal basis, the technical data processed to deliver the website is generally handled to operate and secure the service. We do not use your data for advertising, profiling or automated decisions. [The operator should confirm the legal bases that apply in their jurisdiction after legal review.]

Retention

We do not store your images, so there is nothing to retain or delete on our side. Logs kept by the hosting provider follow that provider’s own schedules. The theme preference in your browser remains until you clear it.

Your choices and rights

You can use the tool without creating an account, clear your browser storage at any time, and use a private window if you prefer. Depending on where you live, you may have rights to ask what personal data we hold, to correct or delete it, to object to processing, or to complain to a data protection authority. Because we intentionally collect very little, a request may result in us confirming that we hold nothing identifiable.

Email and contact

If you email us at compressimageto@gmail.com, we will receive your email address and the content of your message, and we will use it only to respond and to keep a record of the conversation. Please do not send photos of identity documents or other sensitive images by email.

Third-party links

The site may link to other websites. Their privacy practices are their own, so please read their policies before sharing information.
